result.title: Accuracy and Uncertainty in Machine Deception Detection (Research White Paper)
result.summary: A deception detector is only as useful as the trust its alarms deserve. Like a polygraph, detectors that read a language model's internal activations can catch deceptive responses that look honest. Yet current detectors depend on which layers they read, weaken on broader tests, and do not state how certain their alarms are. This white paper proposes the Machine Deception Detector, which targets both detection accuracy and the uncertainty of detector scores. The detector reads every layer of the language model, learns which tokens carry evidence of deception using only response labels, and calibrates its alarm threshold so that its false--positive rate stays below a prescribed level. An ensemble of such detectors measures the uncertainty of each score and raises an alarm only when its members agree, with a confidence level that sets how certain each alarm must be. The proposed evaluation trains on instructed honest and deceptive statements, tests on five unseen deceptive tasks of Liars' Bench read by six Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, and is designed to also show which layers carry the deception feature and how this changes with model size.

AI.brief_summary: 该白皮书提出 Machine Deception Detector：读取语言模型每一层的激活，仅用回答标签学习哪些 token 携带欺骗证据，并校准告警阈值使假阳性率低于预设水平；再用检测器集成衡量分数不确定性，仅在成员一致时告警，计划在 Liars' Bench 的五个未见任务和多个 Qwen3 模型上评估，并观察欺骗特征出现在哪些层及随模型规模的变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其逐层读取内部激活、定位证据 token、报告特征所在层与集成置信度校准的做法，可能为 LVR 中「任务必要信息保留在哪些层/位置」以及置信度与停止决策提供可核查的方法线索；但研究对象是纯文本欺骗检测，与视觉或多模态推理无直接联系。
